programme.title: Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
programme.desc: Prem, a free-spirited boy, falls in love with a young girl Jenny. However, when he learns that she is in love with her college sweetheart, Rahul, Prem sacrifices his love and helps Jenny to get married to the love of her life.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programme.title: Chalta Hai Yaar
programme.desc: Namdev, a man who supplies material for dead people's last rites, is frustrated with being mistreated by his wife and judged by society. When he attempts suicide, a restless soul saves his life and helps him to win back his dignity.

programme.title: Bahurani
programme.desc: Amit wants to marry a modern, independent, strong woman, but his parents get him married to a simple village girl, Madhuri. Amit refuses to see or accept her, prompting Madhuri to change her outer appearance and reenter Amit's life as Malathi.

programme.title: Raja
programme.desc: Madhu and Raja fall in love and decide to get married. However Madhu's two elder brothers oppose their alliance as Raja does not come from a wealthy family. As the story progresses the couple discovers that their families share a bitter past.

programme.title: Dosti: Friends Forever
programme.desc: Karan, a wealthy young boy lives with his emotionally unavailable parents. One day, when he meets with an accident, a homeless orphan named Raj saves his life which gives rise to their unending tale of friendship and brotherhood.

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.

programme.title: Khakee
programme.desc: DCP Anant and his team are assigned to escort an alleged terrorist from Chandangarh to Mumbai. His seemingly simple mission turns into a deadly encounter of survival when a rogue ex-cop turned criminal hinders his way.
